GET /v1/videos/{video_id}/content downloads the MP4 by redirecting to the file, not a JSON file-URL body.
Speech generation returns synchronous WAV audio bytes, and the published Mirage OpenAPI has no JSON speech success body.
POST /v1/videos is multipart/form-data with audio and image or video file bytes, not a JSON body.
